ms.promise:
A. A functioning heuristic analysis engine with an initial set of rule-based detectors for common vulnerability patterns in Aiken code.
B. Data files documenting the vulnerability patterns and rules applied by the engine.
C. A CLI interface that allows developers to run heuristic scans locally.
D. An evaluation dataset containing Aiken scripts with known vulnerabilities for testing.
ms.criteria:
A1. The heuristic analysis engine can successfully scan Aiken code and deliver a structured report of found vulnerabilities.
B1. The data files describing the vulnerability patterns and associated rules are publicly available and consistent with the implemented logic.
C1. The CLI interface can be run by users and successfully executes heuristic scans end-to-end.
D1. The model identifies and reports a non-zero number of known vulnerabilities when run against the evaluation dataset.
